notes: Gold is quoted per gram by karat (21K most popular); the 8 g 21K gold pound is a common coin. Jewelry VAT (14%) is charged on the workmanship value, not the metal. Banky board on 26 Nov 2026: 24K sell 6,450 EGP/g vs about 6,300 at spot and CBE USD rate (~2% over); 21K buy-sell spread about 0.9%. Bar premiums, making and used-gold discounts not sourced.
